Package com.hamsaye.chat.users.services

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
com.hamsaye.chat.users.services.UserService
@Service public class UserService extends Object
Service class for managing user-related operations including saving, updating, deleting, and retrieving user entities.

This service interacts with the UserRepository for data persistence and retrieval, and uses VersionControlConfig to set version control information on user entities.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi

    • saveUser

      public UserEntity saveUser(UserEntity user)
      Saves a user entity.

      Sets the version control information and loyalty status before saving the user entity. If an error occurs during saving, a PersistUserException is thrown.

      Parameters:
      user - the user entity to save
      Returns:
      the saved user entity
      Throws:
      PersistUserException - if an error occurs while saving the user
      Since:
      1.0

    • updateUser

      public void updateUser(UserEntity user)
      Updates an existing user entity.

      Sets the version control information before updating the user entity. The existing user entity is deleted by ID and then the updated user entity is saved. If an error occurs during the process, a PersistUserException is thrown.

      Parameters:
      user - the user entity to update
      Throws:
      PersistUserException - if an error occurs while updating the user
      Since:
      1.0
